antecedent_conditions: Space S is perceptually fluent (high symmetry, golden-ratio proportions, warm materials, natural light — produces positive Type 1 response). Person P has strong negative semantic associations with S (moral objection to the organization housed there, traumatic personal history, cultural stigma).
predicted_outcome:
- Implicit measures (SCR, HR deceleration, early ERP components, eye-tracking fluency) show positive response to S.
- Explicit evaluation is negative.
- ACC conflict signal detected (increased dACC activation, ERN/N2 amplitude increase, response latency increase, confidence decrease).
- Under cognitive load (concurrent dual task), the negative explicit evaluation weakens and the positive implicit response dominates — evaluation shifts toward positive.
moderating_variables:
- Strength of semantic association (stronger negative meaning → stronger override)
- Salience of the semantic cue (if the negative meaning is salient vs. must be recalled)
- Cognitive load (load weakens explicit override)
- Individual differences in need for cognition (high NFC → stronger override maintenance)
expected_effect_sizes:
- Fluency–evaluation dissociation (positive implicit, negative explicit): d ≈ 0.5–0.8
- ACC conflict signal: d ≈ 0.4–0.6
- Response latency increase: d ≈ 0.3–0.5
- Cognitive load moderation: under load, override weakens by d ≈ 0.3–0.5
neural_signature: dlPFC activation (explicit evaluation) co-occurring with medial OFC positive hedonic signal (implicit pleasure), with dACC activation mediating the conflict. Under cognitive load, dlPFC activation decreases and medial OFC signal dominates.
architectural_test_case: Present identical VR environments with and without negative semantic information (building attributed to morally controversial organization vs. neutral organization). Between-subjects attribution manipulation, within-subjects cognitive load manipulation. Measure implicit (SCR, eye-tracking) and explicit (rating, verbal report) channels separately.
overlap_analysis: Overlaps with Placebo Architecture (T_IE_006) and cognitive override mechanisms in Biophilia/Prospect-Refuge.
name: Semantic Override of Perceptual Fluency
